                combo_answers[pid] = ca

                if sc_ok and not combo_ok:
                    b_count += 1
                if not sc_ok and combo_ok:
                    c_count += 1

            combo_n_correct = sum(1 for pid in pids if combo_answers[pid] == gt[pid])
            combo_acc = combo_n_correct / n
            delta_pp = round((combo_acc - sc_acc) * 100, 2)
            p_val = mcnemar_exact(b_count, c_count)

            combo_results[f"w{w}"] = {
                "accuracy": round(combo_acc, 4),
                "correct": combo_n_correct,
                "delta_pp": delta_pp,
                "mcnemar_b": b_count,
                "mcnemar_c": c_count,
                "mcnemar_p": round(p_val, 6),
            }

            sig = "***" if p_val < 0.001 else "**" if p_val < 0.01 else "*" if p_val < 0.05 else ""
            print(f"  Combo w={w}: {combo_acc:.4f} ({combo_n_correct}/{n}), "
                  f"d={delta_pp:+.2f}pp, b={b_count} c={c_count} p={p_val:.6f} {sig}")

        for pid in pids:
            per_question[pid] = {
                "nli_pred": nli_preds[pid],
                "nli_probs": nli_probs_all[pid],
                "sc_answer": sc_answers[pid],
                "gold": gt[pid],
                "sc_correct": sc_correct[pid],
                "nli_correct": nli_preds[pid] == gt[pid],
            }

        nli_right_sc_wrong = sum(1 for pid in pids
                                 if nli_preds[pid] == gt[pid] and sc_answers[pid] != gt[pid])
        sc_right_nli_wrong = sum(1 for pid in pids
                                 if sc_answers[pid] == gt[pid] and nli_preds[pid] != gt[pid])
        both_right = sum(1 for pid in pids
                         if nli_preds[pid] == gt[pid] and sc_answers[pid] == gt[pid])
        both_wrong = sum(1 for pid in pids
                         if nli_preds[pid] != gt[pid] and sc_answers[pid] != gt[pid])

        all_results[gen_name] = {
            "generator": gen_name,
            "verifier": verifier_short,
            "n": n,
            "sc_baseline": round(sc_acc, 4),
            "sc_correct": sc_n_correct,
            "nli_standalone": round(nli_acc, 4),
            "nli_correct": nli_n_correct,
            "combo": combo_results,
            "complementarity": {
                "nli_right_sc_wrong": nli_right_sc_wrong,
                "sc_right_nli_wrong": sc_right_nli_wrong,
                "both_right": both_right,
                "both_wrong": both_wrong,
            },
            "inference_time_s": round(elapsed, 1),
            "per_question": per_question,
        }

    output = {
        "experiment": "FOLIO NLI combo",
        "verifier": args.verifier,
        "verifier_short": verifier_short,
        "dataset": "FOLIO-204",
        "weights": WEIGHTS,
        "generators": all_results,
        "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),

    with open(args.output, "w") as f:

    print(f"\nSaved: {args.output}")
